msg.query = `
    SELECT
        sesi.id AS sesi_id,
        sesi.tanggal,
        sesi.waktu_mulai,
        sesi.waktu_selesai,
        sesi.status AS sesi_status,

        guru_mapel.id AS guru_mapel_id,

        guru.nama_lengkap AS nama_guru,

        mata_pelajaran.nama_mapel,

        kelas.nama_kelas,

        COUNT(presensi.id) AS jumlah_siswa,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'hadir'
        ) AS jumlah_hadir,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'sakit'
        ) AS jumlah_sakit,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'izin'
        ) AS jumlah_izin,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'tanpa_keterangan'
        ) AS jumlah_tanpa_keterangan

    FROM sesi

    JOIN guru_mapel
        ON sesi.guru_mapel_id = guru_mapel.id

    JOIN guru
        ON guru_mapel.guru_id = guru.id

    JOIN users
        ON guru.user_id = users.id

    JOIN mata_pelajaran
        ON guru_mapel.mata_pelajaran_id = mata_pelajaran.id

    JOIN kelas
        ON guru_mapel.kelas_id = kelas.id

    LEFT JOIN presensi
        ON presensi.sesi_id = sesi.id

    WHERE users.id = $1

    GROUP BY
        sesi.id,
        sesi.tanggal,
        sesi.waktu_mulai,
        sesi.waktu_selesai,
        sesi.status,
        guru_mapel.id,
        guru.nama_lengkap,
        mata_pelajaran.nama_mapel,
        kelas.nama_kelas

    ORDER BY
        sesi.tanggal DESC,
        sesi.waktu_mulai DESC;
`;

msg.params = [
    Number(userId)
];

return msg;

func:
const rows = msg.payload?.rows;


/*
====================================================
VALIDASI PAYLOAD
====================================================
*/

if (!Array.isArray(rows)) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Payload rows wajib berupa array."
    };

    return msg;
}


if (rows.length === 0) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Data siswa tidak boleh kosong."
    };

    return msg;
}


if (rows.length > 1000) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Maksimal 1000 siswa per import."
    };

    return msg;
}


/*
====================================================
BERSIHKAN DATA DARI EXCEL
====================================================
*/

const cleanRows = rows.map((row) => {

    return {

        nis: String(
            row.nis ?? ""
        ).trim(),


        nisn: String(
            row.nisn ?? ""
        ).trim(),


        nama_lengkap: String(
            row.nama_lengkap ?? ""
        ).trim(),


        jenis_kelamin: String(
            row.jenis_kelamin ?? ""
        ).trim().toUpperCase(),


        tempat_lahir:
            row.tempat_lahir
                ? String(row.tempat_lahir).trim()
                : null,


        tanggal_lahir:
            row.tanggal_lahir
                ? String(row.tanggal_lahir).trim()
                : null,


        nomor_hp:
            row.nomor_hp
                ? String(row.nomor_hp).trim()
                : null,


        alamat:
            row.alamat
                ? String(row.alamat).trim()
                : null,


        nama_kelas: String(
            row.nama_kelas ?? ""
        ).trim(),


        tahun_ajaran: String(
            row.tahun_ajaran ?? ""
        ).trim()

    };

});


/*
====================================================
QUERY POSTGRESQL
====================================================
*/

msg.query = `

WITH incoming AS (

    SELECT

        row_number() OVER ()::integer AS row_no,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.nis),
            ''
        ) AS nis,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.nisn),
            ''
        ) AS nisn,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.nama_lengkap),
            ''
        ) AS nama_lengkap,

        UPPER(
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(x.jenis_kelamin),
                ''
            )
        ) AS jenis_kelamin,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.tempat_lahir),
            ''
        ) AS tempat_lahir,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.tanggal_lahir),
            ''
        ) AS tanggal_lahir,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.nomor_hp),
            ''
        ) AS nomor_hp,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.alamat),
            ''
        ) AS alamat,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.nama_kelas),
            ''
        ) AS nama_kelas,

        NULLIF(
            TRIM(x.tahun_ajaran),
            ''
        ) AS tahun_ajaran

    FROM jsonb_to_recordset(
        $1::jsonb
    ) AS x(
        nis text,
        nisn text,
        nama_lengkap text,
        jenis_kelamin text,
        tempat_lahir text,
        tanggal_lahir text,
        nomor_hp text,
        alamat text,
        nama_kelas text,
        tahun_ajaran text
    )

),


/*
====================================================
VALIDASI DATA
====================================================
*/

checked AS (

    SELECT

        i.*,

        k.id AS kelas_id,


        CASE


            /*
            ========================================
            NIS
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.nis IS NULL

                THEN 'NIS wajib diisi'


            /*
            ========================================
            NISN
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.nisn IS NULL

                THEN 'NISN wajib diisi'


            /*
            ========================================
            NAMA
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.nama_lengkap IS NULL

                THEN 'Nama lengkap wajib diisi'


            /*
            ========================================
            JENIS KELAMIN
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.jenis_kelamin NOT IN ('L', 'P')

                THEN 'Jenis kelamin harus L atau P'


            /*
            ========================================
            KELAS
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.nama_kelas IS NULL

                THEN 'Nama kelas wajib diisi'


            /*
            ========================================
            TAHUN AJARAN
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.tahun_ajaran IS NULL

                THEN 'Tahun ajaran wajib diisi'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK KELAS DI DATABASE
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN k.id IS NULL

                THEN 'Kelas tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK DUPLIKAT NIS DALAM FILE
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN EXISTS (

                SELECT 1

                FROM incoming d

                WHERE d.row_no <> i.row_no

                  AND d.nis = i.nis

            )

                THEN 'NIS duplikat di file'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK DUPLIKAT NISN DALAM FILE
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN EXISTS (

                SELECT 1

                FROM incoming d

                WHERE d.row_no <> i.row_no

                  AND d.nisn = i.nisn

            )

                THEN 'NISN duplikat di file'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK NIS DI DATABASE
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN EXISTS (

                SELECT 1

                FROM siswa s

                WHERE s.nis = i.nis

            )

                THEN 'NIS sudah terdaftar'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK NISN DI DATABASE
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN EXISTS (

                SELECT 1

                FROM siswa s

                WHERE s.nisn = i.nisn

            )

                THEN 'NISN sudah terdaftar'


            /*
            ========================================
            CEK FORMAT TANGGAL
            ========================================
            */

            WHEN i.tanggal_lahir IS NOT NULL

             AND i.tanggal_lahir !~ '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'

                THEN 'Tanggal lahir harus YYYY-MM-DD'


            /*
            ========================================
            SEMUA VALID
            ========================================
            */

            ELSE NULL

        END AS error_message


    FROM incoming i


    LEFT JOIN kelas k

        ON k.nama_kelas = i.nama_kelas

       AND k.tahun_ajaran = i.tahun_ajaran

       AND k.status = 'aktif'

),


/*
====================================================
KUMPULKAN ERROR
====================================================
*/

errors AS (

    SELECT

        COUNT(*)

        FILTER (

            WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL

        )::integer AS error_count,


        COALESCE(

            jsonb_agg(

                jsonb_build_object(

                    'row',
                    row_no,

                    'nis',
                    nis,

                    'nisn',
                    nisn,

                    'nama_lengkap',
                    nama_lengkap,

                    'message',
                    error_message

                )

                ORDER BY row_no

            )

            FILTER (

                WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL

            ),

            '[]'::jsonb

        ) AS error_rows


    FROM checked

),


/*
====================================================
INSERT KE TABEL SISWA
====================================================

PENTING:

INSERT HANYA DILAKUKAN JIKA
error_count = 0

Jadi:

10 valid
→ 10 masuk

9 valid + 1 error
→ 0 masuk

====================================================
*/

inserted AS (

    INSERT INTO siswa (

        nisn,

        nis,

        nama_lengkap,

        jenis_kelamin,

        tempat_lahir,

        tanggal_lahir,

        nomor_hp,

        alamat,

        kelas_id,

        status

    )

    SELECT

        c.nisn,

        c.nis,

        c.nama_lengkap,

        c.jenis_kelamin,

        c.tempat_lahir,

        NULLIF(
            c.tanggal_lahir,
            ''
        )::date,

        c.nomor_hp,

        c.alamat,

        c.kelas_id,

        'aktif'


    FROM checked c


    CROSS JOIN errors e


    WHERE e.error_count = 0


    RETURNING id

)


/*
====================================================
HASIL AKHIR
====================================================
*/

SELECT

    e.error_count,

    e.error_rows,

    (

        SELECT COUNT(*)

        FROM inserted

    )::integer AS inserted_count


FROM errors e;

`;


/*
====================================================
PARAMETER POSTGRESQL
====================================================
*/

msg.params = [

    JSON.stringify(cleanRows)

];


return msg;

func:
const userId = msg.req.query.user_id;
const tahunAjaran = msg.req.query.tahun_ajaran;
const semester = msg.req.query.semester;


/*
====================================================
VALIDASI
====================================================
*/

if (!userId) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Parameter user_id wajib diisi."
    };

    return msg;
}


if (!tahunAjaran) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Parameter tahun_ajaran wajib diisi."
    };

    return msg;
}


if (!semester || !["1", "2"].includes(String(semester))) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message: "Parameter semester harus 1 atau 2."
    };

    return msg;
}


/*
====================================================
PARSE TAHUN AJARAN
====================================================

Contoh:

2026/2027

Semester 1:
2026-07-01 s/d 2026-12-31

Semester 2:
2027-01-01 s/d 2027-06-30
====================================================
*/

const match =
    String(tahunAjaran).match(
        /^(\d{4})\/(\d{4})$/
    );


if (!match) {

    msg.statusCode = 400;

    msg.payload = {
        success: false,
        message:
            "Format tahun ajaran harus YYYY/YYYY."
    };

    return msg;
}


const tahunAwal =
    Number(match[1]);

const tahunAkhir =
    Number(match[2]);


let tanggalMulai;
let tanggalSelesai;


if (String(semester) === "1") {

    tanggalMulai =
        `${tahunAwal}-07-01`;

    tanggalSelesai =
        `${tahunAwal}-12-31`;

} else {

    tanggalMulai =
        `${tahunAkhir}-01-01`;

    tanggalSelesai =
        `${tahunAkhir}-06-30`;

}


/*
====================================================
QUERY REKAP SEMESTER
====================================================

Data dibatasi berdasarkan:

1. Guru yang sedang login
2. Tahun ajaran
3. Periode semester
4. Guru mapel aktif
5. Kelas aktif
6. Siswa aktif

LEFT JOIN digunakan supaya siswa tetap
muncul meskipun belum memiliki presensi.
====================================================
*/

msg.query = `

SELECT

    guru_mapel.id AS guru_mapel_id,

    guru.nama_lengkap AS nama_guru,

    mata_pelajaran.id AS mata_pelajaran_id,

    mata_pelajaran.kode_mapel,

    mata_pelajaran.nama_mapel,

    kelas.id AS kelas_id,

    kelas.nama_kelas,

    kelas.tingkat,

    kelas.jurusan,

    siswa.id AS siswa_id,

    siswa.nis,

    siswa.nisn,

    siswa.nama_lengkap,

    siswa.jenis_kelamin,


    /*
    ================================================
    JUMLAH PERTEMUAN
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT sesi.id
    ) AS jumlah_pertemuan,


    /*
    ================================================
    HADIR
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(presensi.id)
        FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'hadir'
        ) AS jumlah_hadir,


    /*
    ================================================
    SAKIT
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(presensi.id)
        FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'sakit'
        ) AS jumlah_sakit,


    /*
    ================================================
    IZIN
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(presensi.id)
        FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'izin'
        ) AS jumlah_izin,


    /*
    ================================================
    TANPA KETERANGAN
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(presensi.id)
        FILTER (
            WHERE presensi.status = 'tanpa_keterangan'
        ) AS jumlah_tanpa_keterangan,


    /*
    ================================================
    TOTAL DATA PRESENSI
    ================================================
    */

    COUNT(presensi.id)
        AS jumlah_presensi


FROM guru_mapel


JOIN guru
    ON guru_mapel.guru_id =
       guru.id


JOIN users
    ON guru.user_id =
       users.id


JOIN mata_pelajaran
    ON guru_mapel.mata_pelajaran_id =
       mata_pelajaran.id


JOIN kelas
    ON guru_mapel.kelas_id =
       kelas.id


/*
====================================================
AMBIL SEMUA SISWA DI KELAS
====================================================
*/

JOIN siswa
    ON siswa.kelas_id =
       kelas.id

   AND siswa.status = 'aktif'


/*
====================================================
AMBIL SESI PADA PERIODE SEMESTER
====================================================
*/

LEFT JOIN sesi
    ON sesi.guru_mapel_id =
       guru_mapel.id

   AND sesi.status = 'selesai'

   AND sesi.tanggal >= $2::date

   AND sesi.tanggal <= $3::date


/*
====================================================
AMBIL PRESENSI SISWA
====================================================
*/

LEFT JOIN presensi
    ON presensi.sesi_id =
       sesi.id

   AND presensi.siswa_id =
       siswa.id


/*
====================================================
FILTER GURU
====================================================
*/

WHERE users.id = $1

  AND guru_mapel.status = 'aktif'

  AND guru_mapel.tahun_ajaran =
      $4

  AND kelas.status = 'aktif'


/*
====================================================
GROUP
====================================================
*/

GROUP BY

    guru_mapel.id,

    guru.nama_lengkap,

    mata_pelajaran.id,

    mata_pelajaran.kode_mapel,

    mata_pelajaran.nama_mapel,

    kelas.id,

    kelas.nama_kelas,

    kelas.tingkat,

    kelas.jurusan,

    siswa.id,

    siswa.nis,

    siswa.nisn,

    siswa.nama_lengkap,

    siswa.jenis_kelamin


/*
====================================================
URUTKAN
====================================================
*/

ORDER BY

    kelas.tingkat,

    kelas.nama_kelas,

    mata_pelajaran.nama_mapel,

    siswa.nama_lengkap;

`;


/*
====================================================
PARAMETER POSTGRESQL
====================================================
*/

msg.params = [

    Number(userId),

    tanggalMulai,

    tanggalSelesai,

    tahunAjaran

];


return msg;
